independence_honesty.statement: THIS REVIEW RESOLVES TO THE SAME BACKEND AS THE PACKAGE UNDER REVIEW. On this harness every policy alias currently falls back to one backend, so this red-team review, the concurrent validator review TASK-20260815-fa8f06, and the reviewed producer work TASK-20260815-f04b54 all resolve to models on the SAME backend. 'Independent' here means an independent session, an independent context, and a from-scratch reading of the snapshot bytes. It does NOT mean independent judgement from a different model family.
independence_honesty.corroboration_warning: This batch must not present two same-model reviews as stronger corroboration than they are. Two agreeing reviews from one model are one model's judgement rendered twice, and correlated error is precisely the failure mode that reviewer independence exists to catch. Any decision record citing both must say so.
